2) TTL tests
- Added new test file: test/lru_ttl.test.ts
- Tests cover:
  - TTL expiration excludes entries from size/keys/get/has
  - Per-entry TTL override (ttlMs) works alongside global TTL
  - Expired entries are dropped before eviction (capacity-limited scenario)

Usage examples

- Default: no TTL
  - const c = new LRUCache<string, number>(2)
  - c.set("a", 1)
  - c.set("b", 2)

- Global TTL (entries expire after ttl ms)
  - const c = new LRUCache<string, number>(2, { ttl: 1000 })
  - c.set("a", 1) // expires in 1000 ms
  - c.get("a") // returns 1 if not expired, otherwise undefined

- Per-entry TTL override
  - c.set("x", "value", 100) // expires in 100 ms
  - c.set("y", "value") // uses global TTL if set, otherwise never expires

- Testable time source
  - const c = new LRUCache<string, number>(2, { ttl: 1000, now: () => myFakeTime })
  - myFakeTime can be advanced deterministically in tests
